config.discretization: MAC, N cells, h=1/N; phase-1 operators imported unmodified from stk2d_common.py
config.family: Q=48 affine dictionary (32 solenoidal C psi_q + 16 gradient Grad chi_q) over a 3-D descriptor space (x, y, log-width); amplitudes theta_q(mu) from a curved K=8 map built as a 2-blob superposition of the design's Gaussian kernel
config.bank: psi-route POD: snapshots carried to streamfunction coordinates, POD there, lifted by C.  The naive velocity-space route g_i = X v_i / sigma_i is built alongside as a DIAGNOSTIC to exhibit the 1/sigma_i amplification

S0.rule: solver output dtype float64; JAX x64=True, matmul_precision='highest', backend 'gpu' unless ALLOW_CPU=1.  Phase 2a's numerics are CPU scipy f64 by design (sparse direct); the JAX environment is asserted because phase 2b trains in it

PRECOND.rule: ASSERTED unless SMOKE=1: the ENTIRE configuration -- including the dictionary constants Q, Q_sol, Q_grad, K and grad_mix, which live in stk2d_bank.py and not in the environment -- must equal the frozen contract; the expected gate manifest must be present with EXACT row counts; and no aggregated array may hold a non-finite value.  Python must run WITHOUT -O, checked by a raise rather than an assert.  A SMOKE=1 run NEVER sets complete=true

S5.rule: PRIMARY (design's form): eigen-residual >= 0.5 for every k,l <= min(8, N-1), asserted at N in [64, 128, 256] -- the meshes STOKES-DESIGN.md actually anchored.  THE FLAT 0.5 FLOOR DOES NOT HOLD BELOW N=64 and is NOT asserted there; see the row values.  PRIMARY (mesh-independent form), asserted at EVERY mesh: odd-ghost minimum >= 0.01, and odd-min / even-max >= 1000000.0 -- that ratio is what 'a roundoff value FAILS' actually means.  NEGATIVE CONTROL: the EVEN-ghost operator, for which the curl-sine modes ARE exact eigenvectors, must sit under 1e-13 * N^2 (its roundoff floor grows like eps N^2; a flat ceiling would be wrong).  Anchors {64: (0.769, 0.998), 128: (0.943, 0.999), 256: (0.988, 0.99985)} from STOKES-DESIGN.md S5. SECONDARY: ||A + Lambda B||/||A|| on the auditor's clamped basis must match {64: 0.371, 128: 0.372, 256: 0.373} to 0.002 and lie in [0.3, 0.45] at the anchored meshes, and exceed 0.01 at every mesh -- note the PLUS sign, the convention here is L Phi = -Phi Lambda, so a value this far from 0 means DENSE A IS REQUIRED

S_SOLVE.rule: the factor-once path must agree with the CERTIFIED stk.solve_stokes to 1e-12; the affine superposition identity u(theta) = U_dict theta must hold to 1e-12; blockwise backward errors over ALL 1472 bank solves must meet phase 1's thresholds (global/momentum 1e-13, continuity 1e-12, normalised gauge 1e-12).  The CONTINUITY metric is deliberately NOT phase 1's: phase 1 normalised by ||D||_F ||u|| + |lam| sqrt(n_p), which COLLAPSES on this cell's 16 gradient dictionary atoms (whose exact velocity is zero) and reads 2.5e-2 on a roundoff-clean solve.  The gated form is the standard blockwise backward error for the row block [D | 0 | 1]; phase 1's form is RECORDED as worst_cont_resid_phase1_diagnostic and NOT gated.  The RAW gauge |1^T p| is RECORDED ONLY: phase 1's own forward note says it is not scale-free and its 1e-8 threshold had only 9x margin there; the mass-normalised dictionary here makes ||f||_2 grow like 1/h, so the raw form would trip spuriously.  NEGATIVE CONTROL: a relative 1e-9 perturbation of a converged solution -- still 10x inside phase 1's own 1e-8 field tolerance -- must raise the backward error above 1e-13

S_DICT.rule: Q=48, Q_sol=32, Q_grad=16, full column rank; solenoidal atoms divergence-free to 1e-11 normalised; each atom's OFF-family Hodge energy fraction <= 1e-20.  NEGATIVE CONTROL: the ANALYTICALLY sampled curl of the same Gaussian stream function -- the obvious wrong way to build a solenoidal force -- must exceed 9.999999999999999e-11

S_HODGE.rule: the Hodge partition must be exact to 1e-12, and BOTH mean energy fractions must lie in [0.05, 0.95]: a gradient-dominated dictionary gives large pressure and almost no velocity, and a purely solenoidal one makes the pressure diagnostic vacuous.  ||Grad_h p||/||f|| is recorded per mesh

S_RICH.rule: MANIFOLD RICHNESS -- the verdict this phase exists for.  (a) at least K+1 = 9 independent SOLENOIDAL response directions; (b) centred snapshot numerical rank STRICTLY greater than K = 8, which is exactly the statement that no K-dimensional AFFINE subspace contains the manifold; (c) Jacobian rank of mu -> u equal to K, so the parameterisation is not silently degenerate; (d) held-out POD-K reconstruction error >= 0.001.  (d)'s threshold is MINE, not the design's: rank > K alone is necessary but not sufficient, since a family with a 1e-12 POD-K error would pass it and still leave a nonlinear head nothing to win.  NEGATIVE CONTROL: an AFFINE family with K independent amplitudes, whose centred rank must read EXACTLY K so that gate (b) fires on it

S1.rule: per mode ||D g_i||/(||D|| ||g_i||) <= 1e-11, RE-GATED at all three stages (raw construction, mass normalisation, psi-space reorthogonalisation) and reported against the FOM snapshot divergence AND against sigma_1/sigma_i.  The naive route g_i = X v_i/sigma_i is RECORDED, not gated, and exists to exhibit the 1/sigma_i amplification.  PAIRED NEGATIVE CONTROL: snapshots contaminated with a relative 1e-6 gradient -- the naive route must then exceed 9.999999999999999e-11 while the psi route must still meet 1e-11.  Orthonormality: the REORTHOGONALISED basis at 1e-13 absolute, and the RAW Gram-POD basis at 1e-15 * (sigma_1/sigma_R)^2, which is the Gram POD's own condition-squaring budget

S_MEAN.rule: ||D ubar||/(||D|| ||ubar||) <= 1e-11 for the affine mean.  A non-solenoidal mean makes u = ubar + G h never divergence-free however clean G is.  NEGATIVE CONTROL: the same mean plus a relative 1e-6 gradient must exceed 9.999999999999999e-11

S2.rule: structural ||D C||_inf EXACTLY 0; field path per COLUMN <= 1e-11 both before and after mass normalisation (an aggregate Frobenius form could hide one bad column).  NEGATIVE CONTROL: the same curl-sine modes sampled ANALYTICALLY -- the discrete curl carries 2 sin(k pi h/2)/h where the analytic one carries k pi, and the mismatch leaves an O(h^2) divergence.  EVERY OFF-DIAGONAL (k != l) column must exceed 9.999999999999999e-11 = 10 x the gate tolerance.  The DIAGONAL (k == l) columns are excluded from the control and asserted <= 1e-11 instead: the analytic divergence carries the factor l sin(k pi h/2) - k sin(l pi h/2), which vanishes identically at k == l, so a control taken over ALL columns would read roundoff and could never fire

S_SPEC.rule: the R ladder must come from ONE factorisation, so G_R is the first R columns of G_Rmax BIT-FOR-BIT (max diff exactly 0).  CONTRACT CONFLICT, ASSERTED AS A MEASURED FACT: the frozen contract lists R in {8,16,32,64}, but only the SOLENOIDAL part of the dictionary drives velocity, so the solution manifold has rank at most Q_sol = 32 < 64.  The R = 64 rung is UNREACHABLE at Q = 48, and the certified ladder here is [8, 16, 32].  Ranks come from a DIRECT SVD of the centred snapshots at rtol 1e-09: the Gram POD's own singular values have a sqrt(eps) noise floor and report a far larger rank.  The rank is ASSERTED through the GAP -- sigma_Qsol/sigma_1 >= 1e-06, sigma_(Qsol+1)/sigma_1 <= 1e-09, ratio >= 1000000.0 -- so the cut level cannot silently become the thing that decides the answer

MANIFEST.rule: ASSERTED unless SMOKE=1: every expected gate present, EXACT expected row counts (non-empty is not sufficient), and no non-finite float anywhere in gates/.  Fields that do not apply are recorded as null, never NaN
